name: Uvira
registryAssessment: The national Ministry of Land Affairs officially identifies the cadastral administration and a pilot digitization project, and an official ministry-linked service description says provincial land affairs operate through cadastral jurisdictions. No Uvira-specific local registry custodian, public parcel map, or open parcel lookup was evidenced. National-agency prose is not treated as local registry evidence.

queries.query: Uvira Democratic Republic of the Congo official cadastral map land registry parcel API local government
queries.result: Search found the official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs cadastral site, the official ministry-linked ImmoRDC service description, and BIC (Bureau d'Informations Cadastrales). These establish national cadastral context but exposed no Uvira parcel viewer, safe native parcel identity, CRS, or anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.

queries.query: Uvira cadastre parcellaire République démocratique du Congo carte foncière service officiel
queries.result: La recherche a trouvé le site officiel du Ministère des Affaires Foncières, son projet pilote de numérisation du cadastre et les portails BIC/ImmoRDC. Aucun service public anonyme propre à Uvira ne fournissait une identité parcellaire sûre, une géométrie complète, un schéma ou un SCR; les pages décrivent surtout l'administration nationale et la numérisation des archives.

officialSources.role: National Ministry of Land Affairs official site
officialSources.observation: The site describes the ministry's cadastral remit and displays a pilot cadastral-digitization project; the current page exposes no public Uvira parcel layer or anonymous geometry query.
The page states that cadastre inventories immovable property and that provincial ministry operations use land jurisdictions; it provides no Uvira parcel response or public vector service.
The current site is a professional cadastral platform. Its loaded JavaScript exposed a public aggregate home-count function but no anonymous parcel layer, schema, CRS, or Uvira geometry route.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The exact WUP point [-3.38572977318456, 29.1429622424188] was preserved and not shifted. Missing Uvira-specific viewer/API access is not evidence of citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official DRC national cadastral portals and bounded public routes reviewed for Uvira applicability.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: National cadastral administration and digitization context only; Uvira-specific parcel-vector access, exact-point containment, native identity, schema, CRS, and citywide coverage were not verified.
